Rae (Design): Quick design review 1: metric card grid behaves weirdly around 940px. Primary button nudges when the action overflow appears; toasts slide under the sticky header. Screenshot attached. Thoughts: tweak spacing token or reserve action width?
Omar: I can repro. At ~940px grid drops from 3->2 columns and cards shrink. Reducing horizontal gap seems less invasive.
Maya (A11y): Two accessibility items: 1) keyboard focus can jump out of view after reflow; 2) toasts are currently aria-hidden in the DOM (they shouldn't be). Use role="status" and aria-live="polite".
Rae (Design): Proposal: swap inline gap token from space-5 -> space-4 between 720px-1000px. Fallback: reserve min-inline-size for the .card-actions so CTA doesn't move.
Kai (Frontend): Token-swap is straightforward: single media query to set --card-gap-inline. Reserve width needs truncation testing. Also toasts should use top: calc(var(--nav-height) + var(--space-2)) to avoid overlap.
Omar: If we hide labels on tiny cards, make them icon-only with tooltip. But keep the DOM order stable to avoid focus jumps.
Maya (A11y): When label is visually hidden, add aria-label and include keyboard shortcut in the tooltip (e.g., "Run Query 1 K"). Also enforce focus ring thickness 2px and high-contrast color.
Kai (Frontend): Will prototype the token-swap + toast offset and add aria-label on collapsed buttons. Also ensure toasts only announce once.
design-bot: Created task DR-451: design review follow-up 1 assign reviewers when PR is ready. :white_check_mark:
Rae (Design): Thanks! I'll upload mocks for icon-only vs reserved-width so we can compare. Ping if you hit an edge case.
